verdict.rationale: WorkOS is an identity SaaS that holds customer user data, so a buyer can fairly ask whether that data is excluded from AI model training. The evidence pack has no policy, setting, or contractual term about AI training or opting out of it. Vault encryption and BYOK are related data-protection features, but they are not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
